page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running text throughout, with italic run-in summaries after several paragraph openings. Two chapter headings (CAP. XV. and CAP. XVI.). No margin notes, no running head, no catchword.

p.i: rit debitam Regi obedientiam fubtrahere, quod prætexant decesse non potest) denique Omnes Malignantes & Incendiarios ( quo nomine Omnes Regi adhærentes vel in hoc Fœdus non consensu-rus includerant ) se deserere conaturos & ad cognitionem Publicam & pœnas trahere.

main_text.p: Extat Liber singularis, Judicium Universitatis Oxoniensis de Solenni Liga & Fœdere, in quo singuli Illius Articuli accuratissime examinantur & refelluntur.
main_text.head: CAP. XV.
main_text.p: Dei Causa. Bono Fini. ] Verba multum ab illis usurpata præsertim à Concionatoribus è Sug-gestis in Regem inter manibus[?].
Forisque laccissimus[?]. ] Quando fuit in Hi-spania, à Iesuitis & ipso Pontifice.
Religionum farrago. ] In qua trecentas nonnulli Sectas numerant.
Papistarum auxilia. ] Quorum alii ex Officio Illi militârunt, multi cum alias salvi esse non poterant[?], in Regis Castra compulsi.
Pravos Consiliarios. ] Hos enim in omni Declaratione vehementer exagitabant, vel po-tius sub hoc Nomine Regem ipsum.
main_text.head: CAP. XVI.
main_text.p: Ludibria in Libro utentes. ] Eo enim au-dacia ventum erat, ut Ministros in Ecclesiis legentes deturbarent è Sede, & Librum inibi lacc-rarent[?]; & multa alia Facta & impia.
Æque verba ac sensum? ] Ita enim Directo-rium

page.notes: No printed marginal notes on this page. The blue highlighting over the text is an overlay, not printed, and is not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "rit" at the head of the page (a fragment, kept as printed); "decesse"; "includerant"; "laccissimus" in "Forisque laccissimus"; "inter manibus" (the printed letters look like "int:namibus"); "poterant" (the scan may read "puterant"); "lacc-rarent" (a hyphenated word at the line end whose reconstruction is uncertain). Small mark after "Regem" in the Chapter XV paragraph is a printer's dot, not transcribed.
